assessment: This manuscript is of general interest to Drosophila researchers who widely use the many tools generated by the Gene Disruption Project ( GDP). This is a valuable addition to this toolkit. The approach in this paper generates new vectors, which allow the rapid generation of hundred of gene-specific GAL4 lines using CRISPR technology. The approach taken by the authors has important implications outside the Drosophila community too.
